purpose: Current 53-stock Binance TradFi exact-touch RTH vs non-RTH comparison

comparison.RTH: NYSE official calendar RTH 15m -> RTH 4H/stub + RTH daily; entry only inside RTH trigger bars; management on all Binance 15m
comparison.NONRTH: All Binance 15m -> UTC-native 4H + UTC daily; entry 24h; management on all Binance 15m
comparison.entry_fill: exact planned-price touch: low <= entry <= high
comparison.common_eval_start: per symbol, after both modes have 60 daily bars
comparison.management: TP1 30% -> BE; TP2 30% -> TP1; runner 40% confirmed 4H pivot
